symptom: In Mixed Operation of Work Equipment, Work Equipment with Heavier Load Moves Slower
detail_of_failure: In mixed operation of the work equipment, the work equipment with heavier load moves slower.
related_information: Pre-troubleshooting If a failure code is shown, do the troubleshooting for that code first.

steps.cause: Pressure compensation valve on IN side of arm control valve
steps.procedure: 1. Start the engine. 2. Do boom RAISE and arm IN operations at the same time to do the troubleshooting. 3. Is the movement for the boom RAISE operation normal?

branches.YES: • Pressure compensation valve on IN side of arm control valve is normal. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • Pressure compensation valve on IN side of arm control valve is defective. • Repair and replace the pressure compensation valve on IN side of arm control valve. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.cause: Pressure compensation valve on RAISE side of boom control valve
steps.procedure: 1. Start the engine. 2. Do boom RAISE and arm OUT operations at the same time to do the troubleshooting. 3. Is the movement for the arm OUT operation correct?

branches.YES: • Pressure compensation valve on RAISE side of boom control valve is normal. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • Pressure compensation valve on RAISE side of boom control valve is defective. • Repair or replace the pressure compensation valve on RAISE side of boom control valve. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.cause: Pressure compensation valve on IN side of bucket control valve
steps.procedure: 1. Start the engine. 2. Do boom RAISE and bucket CURL, or arm OUT and bucket CURL operations at the same time to do the troubleshooting. 3. Is the movement for the boom RAISE or arm OUT operation correct?

branches.YES: • Pressure compensation valve on CURL side of bucket control valve is normal. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • Pressure compensation valve on CURL side of bucket control valve is defective. • Repair and replace the pressure compensation valve on IN side of bucket control valve. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.cause: Pressure compensation valve on LOWER side of boom control valve
steps.procedure: 1. Start the engine. 2. Do boom LOWER and arm OUT operations at the same time to do the troubleshooting. 3. Is the movement for the arm OUT operation correct?

branches.YES: • Pressure compensation valve on LOWER side of boom control valve is normal. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • Pressure compensation valve on LOWER side of boom control valve is defective. • Repair or replace the pressure compensation valve on LOWER side of boom control valve. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: 1. Stop the engine. 2. Connect all the component parts. 3. Start the engine. 4. Operate the lever to do the troubleshooting. 5. Does the work equipment operate normally?

branches.NO: Go back to the first check item.
